name: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd (NSE)
tagline: ENTITY NOT YET LISTED/TRADABLE as of this write-up date (2026-09-15) - IPO subscription opens 2026-09-17, listing scheduled 2026-09-24. This is a status note, not a verified equity research verdict.
business_overview: NSE is India's largest stock exchange and multi-asset trading/clearing/listing/data/index-services platform (2,978 listed companies, ~Rs 411 lakh Cr listed market cap as of 31 March 2026 per the IPO prospectus summary). Its IPO has been long-pending for years (widely discussed on the forum and financial media, historically tied up in a co-location/regulatory-settlement overhang) and, as of today (2026-09-15), is NOT yet a tradable listed equity: the IPO subscription window opens 2026-09-17 and closes 2026-09-21, with listing on NSE & BSE scheduled for 2026-09-24. The issue is a 100% offer-for-sale of ~126.44 million shares (existing shareholders selling down; no fresh capital raised), price band Rs 1,700-1,785/share, total issue size ~Rs 22,562 Cr. Per the assignment's explicit instruction, this is written up as an unresolved-entity status note rather than a normal fundamentals verdict.
